info.title: Suovi Message Relay API
info.description: External API for sending messages, checking status, and retrieving message lists through the Suovi messaging platform.

post.summary:
OAuth2 Client Credentials token endpoint.
Issues JWT access tokens for valid API key credentials.
post.description:
Request body format (form-urlencoded):
- grant_type: Must be "client_credentials"
- client_id: The API key client ID
- client_secret: The API key client secret

get.summary:
Health check endpoint for external systems.
Requires a valid API key bearer token.

post.summary:
Checks if a receiver has an active Suomi.fi mailbox.
Requires a valid API key bearer token.

requestBody.description: Request containing the receiver's identity code.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (max 1000 requests per minute).

post.summary:
Sends a new message via the simplified external API.
API key determines the sender mailbox automatically (no MailboxGuid needed).
Requires a valid API key bearer token with write access to at least one mailbox.
post.description:
Rate limit: 1000 requests per minute per API key.
Maximum request size: 10 MB (including message content and attachments).

Example request body:
{
  "receiverName": "Essi Esimerkki",
  "receiverIdentity": "123456-7890",
  "subject": "Message subject",
  "message": "Message body content",
  "externalIdentifier": "your-system-reference-123",
  "allowResponse": false,
  "attachments": [
    {
      "name": "document.pdf",
      "base64": "JVBERi0xLjQK..."
    }
  ]
}

requestBody.description: Simplified message send request with recipient, content, and optional attachments.

201.description: Message successfully created and queued for sending.

403.description: Insufficient permissions (no write access to any mailbox).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (max 1000 requests per minute).

post.summary:
Queries message status by messageId or externalIdentifier.
At least one identifier must be provided in the request body.
Requires a valid API key bearer token with access to the message's mailbox.

requestBody.description: Query request containing messageId and/or externalIdentifier.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (max 1000 requests per minute).

receiverIdentity.description: Receiver's personal identity code (11 characters) or business identity code (9 characters).

CheckMailboxRequest.description:
Request DTO for checking if a receiver has an active Suomi.fi mailbox.
Used by POST /message-relay/v1/check-mailbox endpoint.

ExtAttachmentDto.description: Simplified attachment DTO for message-relay/v1 message sending.

receiverIdentity.description: Receiver's personal identity code (11 characters) or business identity code (9 characters).

externalIdentifier.description: Optional external reference ID for tracking by the calling system (max 100 characters).

allowResponse.description:
Indicates whether the receiver is allowed to respond to this message.
Defaults to false (no response allowed).

attachments.description: Optional attachments to include with the message.

ExtSendMessageRequest.description:
Simplified request DTO for sending a message via message-relay/v1.
API key determines the sender mailbox automatically (no MailboxGuid needed).

messageId.description: Internal message ID (optional if externalIdentifier is provided).

externalIdentifier.description: External reference ID (optional if messageId is provided).

MessageStatusQueryRequest.description:
Request DTO for querying message status by messageId or externalIdentifier.
At least one identifier must be provided.
Used by POST /message-relay/v1/message-status endpoint.

Bearer.description: Enter the JWT token obtained from /message-relay/oauth/token endpoint. Format: Bearer {token}
